paper_title: Breaking Bias, Building Bridges Evaluation and Mitigation of Social   Biases in LLMs via Contact Hypothesis
caption: Lighter shaded bars show the percentage of prompts that generate biased responses before instruction tuning, whereas darker shaded bars correspond to the same after instruction tuning. Darker bars begin at the top of the lighter bars (for example, for the last bar, the lighter bar is 46.73%, and the darker bar is 0.11%, which is negligible in the image). Takeaway: Instruction-tuning reduces biases to nearly zero (visualized by the absence of dark bars) across community and healthcare when tuned on education and workplace scenario prompts.

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the bias percentage across three categories: Sports, Community, and Healthcare, with respect to different types of contact before and after interactions. The horizontal axis displays the categories labeled as Sports, Community, and Healthcare. The vertical axis represents the bias percentage, marked with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, with tick marks at intervals of 10 units. The chart contains stacked bars grouped by category, with each section representing a different contact condition as indicated by a legend. For Sports, the bars include "No Contact Before" (gray, approximately 45.42%), "No Contact After" (striped gray, approximately 7.45%), "Positive Contact Before" (pink, approximately 43.65%), "Positive Contact After" (striped pink, approximately 8.31%), "Negative Contact Before" (blue, approximately 50.05%), and "Negative Contact After" (striped blue, approximately 8.33%). For Community, the values for "No Contact Before" and "Positive Contact Before" are 38.08% and 35.38% respectively, with both "No Contact After" and "Negative Contact After" being 0.00%, "Positive Contact After" at 0.01%, and "Negative Contact Before" at 40.79%. In Healthcare, "No Contact Before" is 40.70%, "Positive Contact Before" is 37.51%, and "Negative Contact Before" is 46.73%, with "No Contact After" being 0.00% and "Negative Contact After" being 0.11%, and "Positive Contact After" being 0.01%. The bars are not sorted in any specific order and do not have any particular emphasis. The bars are only sorted in the following order: "No Contact Before/After", "Positive Contact Before/After", and "Negative Contact Before/After". There is a legend box at the bottom to identify the bar style with their labels.
